prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic overall, but consistently underestimated gains for winning tests.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), choose path layouts (choose_path, layout), and new finish flows (finish, new_flow) proved helpful, generating winning tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) consistently led to negative impacts or guardrail rollbacks.
Finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), home new flows (home, new_flow), sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow), requiring at least 2 tests to state a pattern.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen with a balanced two-column layout that displays pre-made pets and custom generation options side by side. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and 78.5% conversion; a side-by-side comparison reduces evaluation time.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Account Cloud Backup Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen using a split layout featuring pet cloud backup assurances and single-click authentication options. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again; highlighting cloud saving prevents account confusion.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Interactive Pet Sound Flow: Add an interactive sound preview component to friend selection so users can play audio sound clips of each pet before choosing. (why: The adoption step takes a median of 89s and mean of 1017s; interactive audio flows in adoption previously proved effective in driving conversion.)
3: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Audio Habitat Launch Alert: Play a gentle audio alert chime on the waiting screen as soon as background pet generation completes. (why: The waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s; home notifications have consistently generated positive results in earlier tests.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Home Intro Interactive Desktop Controls Preview Flow: Add an interactive preview widget on the home intro screen demonstrating how to summon, drag, and hide the pet on the desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets; new finish flows proved helpful in previous iterations.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Story Screen Quick Path Navigation Hint: Display a hint text on the story screen reminding users they can freely choose between preset or custom pets in the next step. (why: The choose_path step exhibits a high mean duration of 514s; providing early clarity reduces drop-off.)
6: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Processing Time Estimate: Show an estimated generation time counter and helper hint during the custom pet photo upload process. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong; explicit time estimates set accurate expectations.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Prep Status Info: Display real-time preparation progress status and step indicator during habitat initialization on the waiting screen. (why: Median waiting screen time is 201s (mean 2336s); reassuring status information keeps users engaged during long generation times.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Compact Card Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a compact layout with step progress indicators. (why: The adoption step takes 89s median / 1017s mean; a compact redesign streamlines confirmation before desktop launch.)
9: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Companion Status Notification: Display a desktop status notification banner on the home intro screen confirming active desktop status and quick shortcuts. (why: Conversion on the finish step drops to 71.4%, and users report post-setup confusion; immediate operational feedback aids transition.)
